title.orig: An Act Declaring August Fifteen of Every Year a Special Nonworking Public Holiday in the Municipality of Tanauan, Province of Leyte, to Be Known as the "Tanauan Day"

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1994/ra_7689_1994.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The fifteenth day of August of every year, being the annual town fiesta of Tanauan, Leyte, honoring its most holy patron saint, Our Lady of the Assumption, is hereby declared a special nonworking public holiday in the Municipality of Tanauan, Province of Leyte, to be known as the "Tanauan

On August fifteen of every year, the municipal officials of Tanauan, Leyte shall lead appropriate and meaningful celebrations, activities and programs participated in by regional heads of departments and other government offices and their employees holding office in Tanauan, Leyte; civic, sports and other religious and nongovernmental organizations, and private companies doing business in Tanauan, Leyte.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
